sentences.en: The lighthouse was visible landward on the distant shore.
sentences.zh: 远处陆地上可以看到那个灯塔。

sentences.en: As we sailed, the land became more landward and closer to us.
sentences.zh: 随着我们航行，陆地变得越来越近了。

sentences.en: The bird flew landwards over the field towards the village.
sentences.zh: 那只鸟飞向村落，越过田野。

senses.zh: 向陆的/地， 近陆的/地
